title: probtrackx
description: Streamlines tracking algorithm for probabilistic tractography

mask.description: Bet binary mask file in diffusion space
mask.title: Mask file

seed.description: Seed volume, or voxel, or ascii file with multiple volumes, or freesurfer label file
seed.title: Seed file

targetmasks.description: File containing a list of target masks - required for seeds_to_targets classification
targetmasks.title: Target masks list file

waypoints.description: Waypoint mask or ascii list of waypoint masks - only keep paths going through ALL the masks
waypoints.title: Waypoints mask file

network.description: Activate network mode - only keep paths going through at least one seed mask (required if multiple seed masks)
network.title: Network mode flag

seedref.description: Reference vol to define seed space in simple mode - diffusion space assumed if absent
seedref.title: Seed reference volume

dir.description: Directory to put the final volumes in - code makes this directory - default='logdir'
dir.title: Output directory

forcedir.description: Use the actual directory name given - i.e. don't add + to make a new directory
forcedir.title: Force directory name flag

pd.description: Correct path distribution for the length of the pathways
pd.title: Correct path distribution flag

avoid.description: Reject pathways passing through locations given by this mask
avoid.title: Avoid mask file

stop.description: Stop tracking at locations given by this mask file
stop.title: Stop mask file

xfm.description: Transform taking seed space to DTI space (either FLIRT matrix or FNIRT warpfield) - default is identity
xfm.title: Seed-to-DTI transform

invxfm.description: Transform taking DTI space to seed space (compulsory when using a warpfield for seeds_to_dti)
invxfm.title: DTI-to-seed transform

nsteps.description: Number of steps per sample - default=2000
nsteps.title: Number of steps per sample

distthresh.description: Discards samples shorter than this threshold (in mm - default=0)
distthresh.title: Distance threshold

fibthresh.description: Volume fraction before subsidary fibre orientations are considered - default=0.01
fibthresh.title: Fibre volume fraction threshold

sampvox.description: Sample random points within seed voxels
sampvox.title: Sample voxels flag

loopcheck.description: Perform loopchecks on paths - slower, but allows lower curvature threshold
loopcheck.title: Loop check flag

randfib.description: Default 0. Set to 1 to randomly sample initial fibres (with f > fibthresh). Set to 2 to sample in proportion fibres (with f>fibthresh) to f. Set to 3 to sample ALL populations at random (even if f<fibthresh)
randfib.title: Random fibres sampling mode

fibst.description: Force a starting fibre for tracking - default=1, i.e. first fibre orientation. Only works if randfib==0
fibst.title: Starting fibre

s2tastext.description: Output seed-to-target counts as a text file (useful when seeding from a mesh)
s2tastext.title: Seed-to-target text output flag
